basic_info.description: A Charmer with plenty of natural light nestled in the Portola neighborhood of San Francisco! This freshly painted 3 bedroom / 1 bathroom home boasts a large living room, updated eat-in kitchen, remodeled bathroom and a nice size 2 car garage with ample storage and build-out possibilities,  Other amenities include: new vinyl plank flooring throughout, double pane windows, interior skylights and level blank canvas backyard with concrete patio. Steps to Cornerstone Academy and minutes to major freeway thoroughfares, BART, SFO Airport and the bustling Mission Street corridor of shops and restaurants. A must SEE!!!
